HOME ECONOMICS 
 
GENERAL OBJECTIVES 
 
The aim of the Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination (UTME) syllabus in Home Economics 
is to prepare the candidates for the Board’s examination. It is designed to test the candidate 
achievement of the course objectives, which are to: 
 
1. 
Acquire knowledge on the concepts and principles of Home Economics education; 
2. 
Apply the principles of Foods and Nutrition to planning, selection and preparation of meals 
and the adoption of food hygiene and safety; 
3. 
Equip students with knowledge and skills in Clothing and Textiles; 
4. 
Apply the principles of Home Management in home and family living.
